title: Finite freeness of logarithmic differentials at a log-smooth geometric point
statement: Let $f:(X,M)\to(Y,N)$ be a morphism of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], log smooth in the chart sense of [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale]. Fix a geometric point $\bar x$ of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], put $A=\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$ and let $R=\mathcal O_{Y,f(\bar x)}$ act on $A$ by $f$. Define $\omega$ to be the $A$-module on symbols $da$ ($a\in A$) and $d\log m$ ($m\in M_{\bar x}$), modulo additivity and the Leibniz rule for $d$, $dc=0$ for $c$ from $R$, $d\log(mm^{\prime})=d\log m+d\log m^{\prime}$, $d\alpha(m)=\alpha(m)d\log m$, and $d\log f^\flat(b)=0$ for $b\in N_{f(\bar x)}$. Then $\omega$ is a finite free $A$-module: there is an integer $s\geq0$ and an $A$-linear isomorphism $\omega\simeq A^s$.
